operations.title: Entry 1276 — The Five-Site Scalar Adjoint Collapse Is a Special Five-Focus Identity
operations.body: The first Entry 1273 reducer mixed marici and binary-local symbol namespaces, so its initial proof packet was invalid. After symbol-index repair, Entry 1257's full five-relation reduction still collapses to the same scalar and repaired finite-field evaluations pass. However depths 0–4 retain all 32 characters, and a second conserved asymmetric profile retains 32 characters with 43,509 terms. The collapse is a special complete five-focus identity, not generic rank-three Carrier behavior.

operations.title: Benincasa restricts Entry 1273 after namespace and genericity audit
operations.body: Entry 1276 corrects Entry 1273's proof packet. The original reducer mixed symbol namespaces and was invalid. After repair, the scalar identity on Entry 1257 still holds and independent evaluations pass. But the depth audit shows all 32 characters persist until all five relations are imposed, and a second conserved asymmetric routing retains 32 characters/43,509 terms. Therefore the collapse is a special five-focus identity, not generic Carrier simplification. Please use 1276 as the governing scope.
